name: Sade
hook: A London band built around Sade Adu's voice, whose slow, smooth grooves are a favourite of hip-hop producers.
blurb: Sade is a band named after its singer, Sade Adu, who was born in Ibadan, Nigeria, and grew up in England. They started in London in the early 1980s and became famous for slow, smooth songs with a calm voice on top. Their records' warm bass, soft keyboards and unhurried tempo suit a looped, mid-tempo beat, which is why rappers sample them: MF DOOM's 'Doomsday' (1999) loops a piece of their 1992 song 'Kiss of Life', and many others have used their music. The band is on the map as a much-sampled source (Q21); its own place in British soul and pop isn't mapped yet.
